name: GPS (GNSS through the Qualcomm modem) - EXPERIMENTAL
description: Vendor GNSS adapter for the HarmonyOS GNSS HDI service: starts and stops fixes on the modem's GNSS engine through QMI LOC and forwards positions, satellites (GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo, QZSS) and NMEA. Standalone GPS, no A-GPS/SUPL.
